summary: First real Luna dispatch returned empty content: completion_tokens=1200, content=''
root_cause: gpt-5.6-luna is a reasoning model; max_completion_tokens includes reasoning tokens. The 1200-token cap was fully consumed by reasoning before visible content was emitted (retry with 6000 showed reasoning_tokens=316, content=5334 chars). Context window was never the issue - request succeeded at 9,594 prompt tokens.
